canonical_bullets: Designed a reproducible data-cleaning pipeline that merged 5 heterogeneous lab datasets into one training-ready corpus.
Trained a baseline classification model and improved its validation F1 score from 0.71 to 0.84 through feature engineering.
Built automated regression tests that reduced a recurring data-pipeline failure from happening roughly weekly to zero over 3 months.
Presented findings in a lab-wide seminar and incorporated feedback into a revised experiment design.

alternate_bullets_for_dynamic_tailoring: Automated a manual data-labeling step, cutting labeling turnaround time from 2 days to 4 hours.
Integrated a vector database into an internal search prototype and added evaluation scripts the team still uses.

projects.name: Project Atlas
canonical_bullets: Designed a document-classification pipeline covering 6 document categories with a held-out accuracy of 91%.
Built a labeling and evaluation harness that cut manual QA time by half compared to the initial spreadsheet-based process.
Wrote unit and integration tests achieving 85% coverage of the pipeline's core modules.

projects.name: Project Beacon
canonical_bullets: Designed a collaborative-filtering recommendation prototype evaluated on a public 100k-rating dataset.
Improved offline NDCG@10 from 0.41 to 0.53 through hyperparameter tuning and feature engineering.
Packaged the prototype as a reproducible CLI with a documented evaluation harness.

projects.name: Project Meridian

Reduced p95 query latency from 480ms to 190ms by adding an approximate nearest-neighbor index.
